title: Dribble
summary: DRIBBLE, verb intransitive 1. To fall in drops or small drops, or in a quick succession of drops; as, water dribbles from the eaves. 2. To slaver as a child or an idiot. 3. To fall weakly and slowly;

inlines.v: DRIBBLE, verb intransitive 1. To fall in drops or small drops, or in a quick succession of drops; as, water dribbles from the eaves. 2. To slaver as a child or an idiot. 3. To fall weakly and slowly; as the dribbling dart of love. DRIBBLE, verb transitive To throw down in drops.
